The structure of Cs8Sb4F16 (reduced formula Cs2SbF4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 28 atoms in the unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral environments for both Cs and Sb centers: Cs is coordinated by six F neighbors (distances 3.22–3.33 Å), while Sb is coordinated by six F neighbors (2.09–2.12 Å), and the F centers have three geometric neighbors (one Cs, two Sb). The Cs octahedra show corner- and edge-sharing in the validated polyhedron analysis, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
